name: Range breakout with volatility participation (1h)
rationale: A break to the top of the 1h channel is confirmed by realized volatility being ABOVE a floor — participation is rising, meaning real capital is behind the move rather than a drift into the high on fading liquidity. The other side is the passive fader who assumes the quiet-drift high will reverse and is caught by the accelerating flow. Edge persists because breakouts backed by rising realized vol have materially better continuation than low-vol drifts. Distinct from the bandwidth-expansion confirm (vol_realized measures realized move size directly, orthogonal to band geometry). Disconfirmer: exits when realized vol collapses back under a floor (participation gone) or the stop fires.
catalyst: channel-high break with rising realized-volatility participation
